about: A band between two fields of each row, and lines plotted over it. The band is the uncertainty and the line the estimate, so a forecast shows how far it can miss.

forecast.about: Weekly active users as a solid line, the forecast after August 24 as a dashed line, and its 80% interval as a band that widens with the horizon. valueDomain runs the axis from 10,000 to 20,000.
forecast.caption: Weekly active users are forecast to grow to 17,500 by October 5, between 15,500 and 19,500 at 80% confidence.
forecast.label: Weekly active users
forecast.title: Forecast

horizon.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at the last week when the chart first renders. The tooltip writes the band as its two ends.
horizon.caption: The interval on October 5 is 4,000 users wide, against 1,200 a week after the last reading.
horizon.title: Tooltip

narrow.about: The forecast in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone.
narrow.title: Narrow room

quiet.about: A range without rows renders the empty state in the plot's place, at the plot's ratio.
quiet.caption: Forecast of weekly active users.
quiet.empty: The forecast starts after 8 weeks of readings.
quiet.title: Empty

replay.about: animate reveals the band and the line from the start of the axis when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders them at once.
replay.title: Animation

temperature.about: Each day's low and high temperature as a band, and the day's average as a line through it, in degrees Celsius.
temperature.caption: Wednesday was the warmest day, from 14 to 22°C.
temperature.label: Temperature per day in Amsterdam
temperature.title: Daily range

title: Range chart
